driver_profile_about_body: Tashila Driver helps you receive nearby delivery requests, manage each trip step by step, and track your earnings — built for professional drivers in Tamanrasset.

driver_legal_tips_body:
• Go online only when you are ready to accept trips.
• Confirm pickup and drop-off before you start driving.
• Keep your vehicle documents and profile photo up to date.
• Collect cash only after completing the trip in the app.
• Rate clients honestly — it helps everyone.
driver_legal_terms_body: Tashila Driver connects you with delivery jobs in Tamanrasset. By using the app you confirm your documents are valid, your vehicle matches your registered type, and you will follow local traffic and transport rules. Fares shown are estimates; final price follows the completed trip. We may update these terms; continued use means acceptance of the latest version.
driver_legal_privacy_body: Tashila stores your profile, documents, trip history, and earnings to operate the service. Location is used while you are online or on an active trip. We do not sell your data. If you delete your account, your saved data on this device is removed according to our retention policy.
